source_locations.1875_experimental: Ambient conventional orthorhombic cell contains 12 Fe and 4 C, Z=4. a=5.088 +/- 0.002 A, b=6.742 +/- 0.003 A, c=4.526 +/- 0.003 A; V0=155.26 +/- 0.14 A^3. 16:3:1 methanol-ethanol-water medium; external heating to about 500 K between measurements above 15.4 GPa. Ruby fluorescence cites Mao et al. (1978), not Mao (1986). Separate laser-heated runs had no medium.
source_locations.1876_eos_paragraph: Weighted least squares; BM3 K0=175.4 +/- 3.5 GPa, K0-prime=5.1 +/- 0.3; Vinet 175.1 +/- 3.6 and 5.3 +/- 0.3; BM2 186.5 +/- 2.9 GPa. Fixed-K0-prime fits from 2.5 to 7 summarized by K0=226.7 - 9.97 K0-prime GPa. No fixed/free V0 declaration, numerical P-V table, confidence definition, row weights or residual direction found.
source_locations.1876_figure1: Highest diffraction pattern labelled 73.2 GPa, distinct from rounded title/abstract maximum
source_locations.1877_figure3_caption: Pressure-volume data from two runs; weighted fits; third-order BM and Vinet drawing indistinguishable. Open circle is temperature-quenched from >1500 K at 16 GPa. Caption does not explicitly declare its fit inclusion/exclusion or identify run membership point by point.
source_locations.1878_references_and_end: Mao, Bell, Shaner and Steinberg (1978), J. Appl. Phys. 49, 3276-3283; no data table or supplement/correction notice in inspected final article
